## Summary

Describe the problem and behavioral change.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests and appropriate checks passed.
- [ ] Authorization-sensitive changes include negative tests.
- [ ] No live instance URLs, secrets, user data or generated files were committed.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO Signed-off-by trailer.
- [ ] SPDX headers are present or the file has a specific REUSE exception.
- [ ] Documentation is accurate.

## Deployment and rollback

Document migration risks and rollback behavior, or mark as not applicable.
